title: Gen Through the Lens: Camera-Controllable Video Generation via Cross-Coordinate Conditioning Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.15900v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Gen Through the Lens, a camera-controllable image-to-video generation framework that synthesizes videos from a given reference image while enabling realistic and physically consistent camera operations. Unlike previous models that treat camera motion as abstract conditioning or rely on a single coordinate system, our approach explicitly decomposes and fuses control signals across three coordinate spaces: the camera coordinate (modeled by intrinsic parameters), the world coordinate (represented by spatial geometry hints), and the object coordinate (described by 3D bounding boxes of target subjects). Through cross-coordinate conditioning fusion, these heterogeneous cues are unified to guide the generative process, enabling precise control of camera motion, focus, and framing while preserving temporal and spatial coherence. translated_title: 镜头视角生成：通过跨坐标条件融合实现相机可控的视频生成
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Gen Through the Lens，这是一个相机可控的图像到视频生成框架，能够从给定的参考图像合成视频，同时实现逼真且物理一致的相机操作。与以往将相机运动视为抽象条件或依赖单一坐标系的模型不同，我们的方法显式地在三个坐标空间中分解并融合控制信号：相机坐标系（由内参参数建模）、世界坐标系（由空间几何提示表示）以及物体坐标系（由目标主体的3D边界框描述）。通过跨坐标条件融合，这些异构线索被统一起来引导生成过程，从而实现对相机运动、对焦和取景的精确控制，同时保持时间与空间的一致性。大量实验表明，我们的方法能够生成可控且视觉一致的结果。
tldr: 该论文提出Gen Through the Lens框架，通过在相机、世界和物体三个坐标系中分解并融合控制信号，实现了图像到视频生成中对相机运动、对焦和取景的精确且物理一致的控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Gen Through the Lens, a framework that decomposes and fuses control signals across camera, world, and object coordinate systems, enabling precise and physically consistent control of camera motion, focus, and framing in image-to-video generation.
